headline.purpose: Section names, player identities, and the current phase.

body.purpose: Labels, prompts, lists, and general interface copy.

body-compact.purpose: Adjacent phases, history, empty states, and supporting text.

metadata.purpose: Resource labels and values, mana pips, battlefield captions, and card state.

motion.name: phase-slide
motion.purpose: Consecutive protocol phases slide left 136px in ten 15ms frames; nonconsecutive and lifecycle-changing updates are immediate.

motion.name: hand-card-lift
motion.purpose: A hovered native-button card grows to approximately 160px and rises from 58px to 30px; selection remains stronger at approximately 180px and 4px.

components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: Recommended protocol actions such as connect, keep hand, pass priority, and confirm.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #31554f; color: #f5fffd; padding: 10px 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; font: 600 9pt "Segoe UI Semibold", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #416f67; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: auto; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Action Button
components.description: Supporting protocol actions that are available but not the recommended next action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #303b3b; color: #eee8dc; padding: 9px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; font: 600 9pt "Segoe UI Semibold", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover, .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: #3b4847; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: auto; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { background: #252d2d; color: #899591; }

components.name: Danger Action Button
components.description: Destructive match action reserved for concession.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: #5a3732; color: #ffe9e2; padding: 9px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; font: 600 9pt "Segoe UI Semibold", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-btn-danger:hover, .ds-btn-danger:active { background: #3b4847; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: auto; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Connection Text Field
components.description: Editable server, player, and deck connection values.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 7px; color: #eee8dc; font: 400 10pt "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-field input { background: #f4f1e8; color: #182021; padding: 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; font: inherit; } .ds-field input:hover { background: #f4f1e8; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: auto; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Semantic Card Tile
components.description: A native-button card tile with a cached rounded transparent sprite, catalog-derived outline, and explicit state caption.
components.css: .ds-card { display: inline-grid; width: 144px; background: #202a2b; color: #eee8dc; border: 2px solid #D76A5B; border-radius: 14px; overflow: hidden; font: 400 9pt "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-card:hover { width: 160px; border-width: 4px; transform: translateY(-28px); } .ds-card:focus-within { border-width: 6px; } .ds-card-art { min-height: 201px; display: grid; place-items: center; } .ds-card-state { color: #d99986; padding: 2px 3px 3px; font: 600 8pt "Segoe UI Semibold", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; }

components.name: Battlefield Resource Strip
components.description: Player identity and public resources remain adjacent to the battlefield.
components.css: .ds-resources { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 16px; background: #24302f; color: #eee8dc; padding: 5px 0; } .ds-resources:hover { background: #24302f; } .ds-player { display: grid; min-width: 90px; } .ds-player strong { color: #d8bd88; font: 700 12pt Georgia, serif; } .ds-player span, .ds-metric span { color: #899591; font: 400 8pt "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-metric { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px; } .ds-metric i { color: #78c9be; font-style: normal; } .ds-metric strong { font: 600 8pt "Segoe UI Semibold", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-mana { background: #D76A5B; color: #101617; padding: 1px 4px; font: 700 8pt "Segoe UI", sans-serif; }

components.name: Phase Flow
components.description: Previous, current, and next protocol phases form a compact flowing status strip.
components.css: .ds-phase { width: 410px; height: 34px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 112px 18px 138px 18px 112px; align-items: center; background: #182021; overflow: hidden; } .ds-phase:hover { background: #182021; } .ds-phase span { color: #899591; font: 400 9pt "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-phase span:first-child { text-align: right; } .ds-phase b { color: #78c9be; text-align: center; font-weight: 400; } .ds-phase strong { color: #d8bd88; text-align: center; font: 700 12pt Georgia, serif; }

components.name: Choice Dialog
components.description: A modal decision surface for targets, ordering, and blocker assignment.
components.css: .ds-dialog { width: 360px; display: grid; gap: 10px; background: #182021; color: #eee8dc; padding: 18px; border: 1px solid #3a4847; border-radius: 0; } .ds-dialog:hover { background: #182021; } .ds-dialog h2 { margin: 0; color: #d8bd88; font: 700 12pt Georgia, serif; } .ds-dialog select { background: #f4f1e8; color: #182021; padding: 8px; border-radius: 0; } .ds-dialog select:focus-visible, .ds-dialog button:focus-visible { outline: auto; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-dialog button { margin-top: 8px; background: #31554f; color: #f5fffd; padding: 10px 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; font: 600 9pt "Segoe UI Semibold", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-dialog button:hover, .ds-dialog button:active { background: #416f67; }

narrative.overview:
The client is a focused tabletop control surface: dark, calm, readable, and lightly tactile. Charcoal framing and green-black felt establish the play surface, warm parchment headings provide restrained ceremony, and teal marks priority, direction, and actionable state. The visual system keeps attention on the server-authoritative game state rather than ornamental fantasy chrome.

The interface follows the match itself: connect, scan both players' resources at their battlefields, follow the current phase and priority, select cards, act through the protocol, and read the authoritative response. Real card frames and color-semantic outlines carry card identity; the surrounding application remains quiet and functional.
keyCharacteristics: Dark charcoal and felt surfaces with flat tonal separation.
Warm Georgia headings paired with compact Segoe UI controls and metadata.
Restrained teal for priority, flow arrows, icons, and primary actions.
Card-color outlines and mana pips that supplement, never replace, text and position.
Responsive stacking, bounded scrolling, and one brief phase-flow animation.

rules.name: The Teal Means Agency Rule
rules.body: Reserve teal for priority, flow, resource cues, and primary actions; it is not a decorative wash.

rules.name: The Card Identity Rule
rules.body: Use the catalog-derived W/U/B/R/G, colorless, or multicolor outline for cards, while retaining text, focus, and position cues so color never acts alone.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Georgia speaks only for identity and hierarchy; Segoe UI carries operations and state.

rules.name: The Adjacent State Rule
rules.body: Put each player's public resources directly beside that player's battlefield so evaluation does not require cross-screen searching.

rules.name: The Flat Table Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce drop shadows, gloss, glass, or ornamental bevels; distinguish layers with tone, border, and spacing.

dos: Do preserve the charcoal, felt, parchment, teal, and semantic card-color roles exactly.
Do keep public resources adjacent to their battlefield and the contextual actions beside or immediately below the board.
Do keep battlefield cards in straight strips and reserve overlap, hover lift, enlargement, and bounded navigation for the player's hand.
Do retain text, focus, size, and position cues alongside semantic color.
Do keep the 1180-pixel responsive transition and both axes of overflow usable down to the 760-by-600 minimum window.
Do limit motion to the 150-millisecond consecutive-phase slide and 90-millisecond hand-card lift; both transitions explain state and remain interruptible.
donts: Don't add ornamental fantasy chrome, gradients, glass effects, drop shadows, or decorative texture.
Don't add a redundant full phase rail; preserve the flowing previous-current-next phase strip.
Don't detach resources into a remote dashboard or move game authority into the presentation layer.
Don't replace native card buttons with canvas-only hit targets; composite the rounded image separately and preserve the proven input path.
Don't rely on color alone for card identity, selection, focus, damage, or disabled state.
Don't introduce web-only navigation, chips, hover-dependent actions, or browser layout claims into this Tkinter desktop system.
